Sara / Marissa — quick legal note on sequencing and redline handling so expectations are clear from our side: 

- NDA: agree — sign first so we can share security artifacts. We will not push redlines on the NDA unless there are material commercial points.
- MSA redlines: please send a single consolidated redline doc with comments. That helps us avoid back-and-forth over piecemeal edits. We typically aim to return a consolidated response within 5 business days from receipt of the redline set.
- DPA/security items: we can accept a DPA redline and security questions in parallel, but if there are bespoke security controls requested (e.g., specific encryption or retention changes), those can add time — we will flag them immediately.
- Procurement: once the MSA is agreed and countersigned, procurement can issue a PO. If they require an earlier PO for vendor creation, we can provide a W9 and billing contact (Dev Patel) to speed vendor setup.

Happy to jump on a quick call with Sara if helpful to walk through our typical clauses and the turn times.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
